title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: The task is never stated in plain words. A reader who has forgotten it has to piece together from the options that two fields (`automatic`, `triggerType`) are being added to the `tasks_list` output under a size limit.
It uses the internal id T91BFC0 with no description. Jargon like `LIST_BUDGET`, `PAGE_SIZE`, 'budget', 'fixture', `task_get` and `triggerType` is never explained.
At roughly 200 words it is well over the 120-word limit, and the clipped, telegraphic phrasing makes it harder to read.
Why the question exists comes through: the size limit is too small, backed by byte estimates.

The options mostly say what happens to the reader (field shape changes, about 800 more bytes per page, more pages). A recommendation is given (option 1), and the default is stated: nothing gets built until the owner answers.
